H1_overall: H1 requires BOTH tiers [120, 300] for its arm B clause. Tier 120: FAIL at this tier (least favourable drop 1.6827 pp). Tier 300: FAIL at this tier (least favourable drop -2.6769 pp). H1's arm A clause is separately falsified at tier 300 by a reproduced restart row (AMD-MPE8-13). The margin was not moved and no tier was dropped.

tier_120.rule_applied: D-MPE8-06: H1 is carried by the least favourable seed, and if the observed seed spread exceeds the registered margin the claim is NOT DECIDABLE at this tier rather than passed. The margin itself is not adjusted.

h1_tier_300.rule_applied: D-MPE8-06: H1 is carried by the least favourable seed, and if the observed seed spread exceeds the registered margin the claim is NOT DECIDABLE at this tier rather than passed. The margin itself is not adjusted. Applied here exactly as at tier 120, including which end of the drop counts as unfavourable.

interpretation_at_this_absolute_level.carried_from_tier_120: if arm B's session-1 level at tier 300 is at or near its tier-120 level of 6-7 percent, a 5 pp margin cannot separate 'forgot' from 'never knew' at that absolute level
interpretation_at_this_absolute_level.statement: Arm B's session-1 live rate at tier 300 is 1.15-1.63% of 1,046 asks, at or near the 6.25-7.45% it reached at tier 120. The registered margin asks arm B to drop BY at least 5.0 percentage points, and from a baseline of about 7 percent that is most of everything the model ever said correctly. At this absolute level the margin cannot separate 'forgot' from 'never knew' -- a system that scored 7% at session 1 and 2% at session 3 has lost nearly all of a competence it barely had, and a system that stayed at 7% may simply never have had the items the battery asks about. H1's FAIL at tier 120 stands, the margin is left exactly where it was registered, and this note is an interpretation of the measurement, not a change to it.

score_definition: live-phase correct rate = sum(correct)/sum(n) over the by_shape table of summary.B.<depth>.live -- the same definition the tier-120 verdict used
spread_definition: max minus min across the three seeds of the same quantity, reported for the session-1 score, the session-3 score and the drop statistic

what_this_result_does_not_say.arm_B_did_not_run_at_tier_40_under_this_: tier 40 is the calibration tier and cannot carry H1, per the registered tiers block
what_this_result_does_not_say.no_tier_was_dropped: tier 300 is measured here precisely because tier 120 came out awkward
what_this_result_does_not_say.the_margin_was_not_renumbered: the registered 5.0 pp minimum drop is used as written at both tiers
